records.label: SPACE ... THE FINAL FRONTIER aka the SPACE between the EARS as my grandmother said
records.detail: Verbatim family saying as relayed by Nathan Tabor; this is the owner-authored attribution, not a claim of Sanskrit textual origin.

records.label: ME R U U R ME
records.detail: Exact six-token mirror [ME,R,U,U,R,ME]; continuous letters MERUURME are not a character palindrome.

records.label: ME R U U R EM
records.detail: Owner variant; EM = mother in owner's wordplay. Continuous letters MERUUREM form an exact eight-character palindrome.

records.label: Mount Meru is Mount Tabor
records.detail: Owner-authored symbolic identification. Historical equivalence and linguistic derivation are not established by cited Sanskrit sources.

records.label: Christ Light is Tabor Light - Mount Meru
records.detail: Owner's symbolic/theological statement, stored verbatim as a creator interpretation rather than an externally verified historical claim.

records.label: A1Z26 of MERUUREM = 114
records.detail: M=13 E=5 R=18 U=21 U=21 R=18 E=5 M=13, sum 114. Outer MERREM sum 72; central UU sum 42. Arithmetic identity does not demonstrate historical derivation of 114 chakras.

records.label: Six-token palindrome ME|R|U|U|R|ME
records.detail: Mirror at token granularity; original first spelling is not a letter-level palindrome.

records.label: Mount Meru (मेरु)
records.detail: In several Hindu and Buddhist cosmological traditions, Meru is a central cosmic mountain or axis; not an anatomical object.

records.label: Merudaṇḍa (मेरुदण्ड)
records.detail: Sanskrit compound used for vertebral column/spinal axis; bodily Meru is a metaphor in yogic contexts.

records.label: Yathā piṇḍe tathā brahmāṇḍe
records.detail: Microcosm-macrocosm maxim, widely used in Indic explanatory traditions. Exact provenance and dating should be checked before attributing it to one ancient verse.

records.label: Hiraṇyagarbha
records.detail: Cosmic golden embryo/egg in Indic cosmologies; comparing it with the Kanda is an interpretive analogy, not necessarily a direct identification in the quoted Hatha passages.

records.label: Kanda (कन्द)
records.detail: Egg-/bulb-like subtle origin of nāḍīs, commonly located between genitals and navel in Hatha descriptions. Not an identified physical organ.

records.label: Nābhi marma
records.detail: Traditional vital-point designation near the navel; Ayurvedic marma theory is distinct from physically identified autonomic nerve plexuses.

records.label: Maṇipūra (मणिपूर)
records.detail: Ten-petalled navel center with a fire triangle and the Raṃ seed syllable in Śaṭcakranirūpaṇa verse 19.

records.label: Navel–sun and palate–moon inversion
records.detail: Haṭhapradīpikā describes symbolic lunar nectar and a solar consuming fire; its inversion practice should not be read as literal skull fluid transfer.

records.label: Enteric nervous system
records.detail: Neural networks within the digestive tract coordinate digestion and communicate with central nervous system; this is distinct from subtle nāḍīs.

records.label: Vagus nerve
records.detail: Major autonomic route for two-way brain–viscera communication; not equivalent to a chakra or nāḍī.

records.label: Jaṭharāgni
records.detail: Metaphorical and functional Ayurvedic digestive fire, not literal combustion of hydrogen in the gut.

records.label: Ākāśa / space
records.detail: One of the five mahābhūta elements; linking it to actual intergalactic distances is metaphorical.

records.label: Kṣīra Sāgara / ocean of milk
records.detail: Cosmic ocean in Hindu narratives; belly–ocean churning is a creative physiological analogy, not a universally documented interpretation.

records.label: Ākāśagaṅgā / celestial river
records.detail: Milky Way as celestial river; comparison to intestinal neural network is an analogy, not a textual claim about modern neuroscience.

records.label: 114 chakras: 112 internal + 2 external
records.detail: Isha Foundation: 112 internal organized as 7 dimensions × 16 aspects; 108 workable, four flower as a consequence.

records.label: 114 chakras: 7+21+86
records.detail: Amit Ray classification 7 major, 21 minor and 86 macro (book contents); the user's pasted text calls 86 'micro'. Preserve the discrepant labels.

records.label: 14 upper/lower chakras
records.detail: Himalayan Academy: 7 upper and 7 below the spine, with psychological attributes as taught by that institution.

records.label: Seven principal centers
records.detail: Widely circulated seven-center schema; specific functions, sounds, elements and colors vary across traditions and modern teaching.

records.label: Four/five centers in some Buddhist Tantric traditions
records.detail: Varying Buddhist Tantric mappings use head/throat/heart/navel and sometimes secret center; no single universal list.

records.label: Twelve meditative centers in Vijñānabhairava verse 30
records.detail: Verse references twelve successive positions associated with twelve letters; detailed contemporary point-by-point lists should not be attributed to this verse alone.

records.label: Multiple 9, 10, 12, 21+ Tantric configurations
records.detail: Traditions vary by initiation, region, text and purpose; unspecified individual names are not fabricated.

records.label: 72,000 nāḍīs
records.detail: Traditional count in some subtle-body lineages, emanating from kanda; neither 72,000 individually named entries nor physical channels.

records.label: 13 Ayurvedic agnis
records.detail: Charaka-derived count: 1 jaṭharāgni, 5 bhūtāgni and 7 dhātvāgni. Other Ayurvedic texts enumerate differently.

records.label: Five vital winds
records.detail: Prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, vyāna are yogic functional categories; mapping them to gravity/solar wind is separately a creator metaphor.

records.label: Five mahābhūtas
records.detail: Pṛthvī (earth), ap (water), tejas (fire), vāyu (air), ākāśa (space).

records.label: 246 existing STREAMING CONSCIOUSNESS pillars
records.detail: Reference-only linkage to 33 spinal + 7 question + 206 bone positions; this new atlas does not redefine original pillar names or replace their canonical records.

records.label: Mūlādhāra
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 1: base of spine; its taught association is memory, time and space. Element earth; syllable LAM are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Svādhiṣṭhāna
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 2: below navel; its taught association is reason. Element water; syllable VAM are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Maṇipūra
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 3: solar plexus / navel; its taught association is willpower. Element fire; syllable RAM are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Anāhata
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 4: heart; its taught association is direct cognition. Element air; syllable YAM are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Viśuddha
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 5: throat; its taught association is divine love. Element space; syllable HAM are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Ājñā
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 6: brow; its taught association is divine sight. Element not consistently assigned; syllable OM in some modern presentations are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Sahasrāra
records.detail: Himalayan Academy higher center 7: crown; its taught association is illumination. Element transcends five-element system; syllable silence in some lineages are comparative, tradition-dependent overlays.

records.label: Pātāla

records.label: Prāṇa
records.detail: Traditional inward intake, breathing, swallowing; located conceptually at chest/upper torso. The proposed cosmic counterpart 'solar wind / cosmic expansion' is a modern metaphor, not a measured force equivalence.

records.label: Apāna
records.detail: Traditional downward movement, elimination; located conceptually at pelvis/lower abdomen. The proposed cosmic counterpart 'gravity/downward pull' is a modern metaphor, not a measured force equivalence.

records.label: Samāna
records.detail: Traditional assimilation, digestion and balancing; located conceptually at navel. The proposed cosmic counterpart 'gravitational equilibrium' is a modern metaphor, not a measured force equivalence.

records.label: Udāna
records.detail: Traditional upward movement, speech, effort; located conceptually at throat/head. The proposed cosmic counterpart 'rising heat and ascension' is a modern metaphor, not a measured force equivalence.

records.label: Vyāna
records.detail: Traditional circulation and pervasive distribution; located conceptually at whole body. The proposed cosmic counterpart 'all-pervading space' is a modern metaphor, not a measured force equivalence.

records.label: enteric plexuses

records.label: diaphragm

records.label: brain

records.label: spinal cord
records.detail: Major CNS pathway for sensory, motor and autonomic signals.
